summary: SK hynix filed a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026, disclosing a board resolution to cancel treasury shares. The company plans to acquire and cancel approximately 24,070,000 common shares, valued at about KRW 40 trillion (based on the August 18, 2026 closing price of KRW 1,662,000 per share), through open-market purchases from August 20 to November 19, 2026. The acquisition is limited by distributable profits under the Korean Commercial Act, and the cancellation will reduce issued shares without changing capital. SK Securities acts as brokerage agent. The exact share count may adjust with price movements. Watch for execution progress and share price support.
